notes: POC objective: validate Dedicated capacity for low-latency customer chat (real-time support) and bursty semantic search; confirm reserved GPU sizing and SLA commitments.

Workload details: ~300 concurrent chat sessions during business hours with occasional spikes to 800 concurrent sessions; representative prompt lengths 20-400 tokens; heavy short-turn conversations (avg 60 tokens/session).

Performance targets: median latency <150ms for short turn responses (~<=64 tokens); p95 <=350ms, p99 <=600ms under sustained load; throughput target steady-state ~150 qps and peak bursts up to 400 qps.
Reserved GPU plan: initial baseline 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB (pin to model variants); target scale to 8x H100 during peak/holiday; test quantized 13B and 7B variants to validate cost/perf tradeoffs.

POC test plan: synthetic load (k6) with production-like session multiplexing; soak test 48h to surface memory leaks/KV cache drift; representative prompt set of 250 queries pulled from production logs (anonymized).
Fall-back strategy: automatic routing to quantized 7B model for capacity-constrained periods; evaluate degraded-mode SLO with fixed% quality drop acceptance.

SLA negotiation focus: clearly defined latency SLOs by token-length buckets, throughput SLO (tokens/sec) per reserved unit, error budget policy and credits, scheduled maintenance windows and notification windows, escalation path and dedicated SE time for first 90 days.
Security notes: require SSO/SAML integration, KMS-backed key management, audit logging to customer SIEM, contractual data residency (US only) for chat transcripts; security questionnaire in drive.

Cost sensitivity: high — finance asked for modeled unit economics showing per-1M-token cost at 4x vs 8x H100 with and without quantization; Redwood Optimize recommendations required for quantization/autobatching knobs.

POC observations so far: latency p95 spikes correlated with KV cache misses during long-context sessions; batching configuration adjustments reduced median latency by ~18% in second run; memory utilization steady on H100 over 24h.

Next technical steps: run 48h soak on 4x H100 with production prompt set, test autoscale burst to 8x H100 for 2h spike, collect per-route token cost and p99 histograms, capture trace IDs for postmortem.
Commercial next steps: finalize SOW with reserved capacity tiers, clarify SLA credits model and termination clauses, align procurement paperwork (vendor security addendum) — target close 2026-06.
